lines.l: Yes, I'm leaving the sorrow of heartache
Before they take me away from my mind
Send me love and I may let you see me
And behold, I can fit in my head
But if you really want me to quench up
I could only let you know I'm not dead
I'll realize I'm not better without you
You're not the one and only thing in my heart
I'll just go back to pretending I'm living
But this time I'm gonna have to stop my heart
